dict.string: When you turn on “Use my location” in Settings, Vaelo uses your approximate location (about a kilometre) so questions like the weather or what’s nearby just work.
When you turn on “Use my location” in Settings, Vaelo uses your approximate location (about a kilometre) so questions like the weather or what’s nearby just work.
Vaelo uses your microphone to turn your spoken words into a draft. Audio is sent for transcription only when you finish a recording.
